hooks.command: input=$(cat); fp=$(echo "$input" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null); [ -f "$fp" ] && case "$fp" in *.py) conda run -n rlft_ms3 python -m black "$fp" --quiet 2>/dev/null ;; esac; exit 0

input=$(cat); fp=$(echo "$input" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null); case "$fp" in */rlft/vlaw/*|*/ctrl_world/*) echo "[VLAW] 已修改 $fp — 记得在任务结束前更新 .github/vlaw-status.md" ;; esac; exit 0
